fields.v: SDAD (Spec-Driven Agentic Development) framework and SDAD-V model, proposed by the authors; no version, no tool implementation

Reviewable intent record / intent doc; formal, machine-interpretable specification (interfaces, logic, data structures, acceptance criteria; YAML-based logic or structured natural-language templates; security requirements as first-class fields); synthesis output (code, tests, deployment artefacts); verification report; provenance log (link from merged artefacts to spec revision, model route, gate outcomes)

Four steps: (1) intent capture (structured human-agent dialogue); (2) formal specification; (3) agentic synthesis (multi-file generation of code and tests); (4) independent multi-agent verification (test, security, conformance gates) then human sign-off. SDAD-V: Stakeholder Intent -> Spec Architect -> Formal Specification -> Spec Fidelity Gate -> Agentic Implementation -> Agentic Verification, with feedback loops. Adoption: Phase 0 Assessment, 1 Pilot, 2 Hybrid, 3 SDAD-first, with gates

Spec Fidelity Gate (completeness, consistency, traceability) after the formal spec; human (Spec Architect or accountable reviewer) sign-off on merge/release after verification; human sign-off on requirements in AI-assisted Waterfall phases; migration gates (spec clarity, verification pass rate, repair multiplier, security)

Inconsistencies: Ambiguity Tax curve (Fig. 3, H(C)=e^(-0.045C), 70% threshold) attributed to 'empirical data from [4]', but [4] (Cursor adoption, MSR'26) does not measure spec clarity vs hallucination; token price anchor 'USD 0.05 per million tokens' for frontier models is implausibly low and drives the 99% figures; Table 6 SDAD column does not add up: delivery labour ~USD 400 + management overhead ~USD 600 + tokens ~USD 0.20 gives ~USD 1,000, yet TCI is given as ~USD 600 (-99%); the Agile column adds up (48,000 + 12,000 = 60,000); text refers to 'Table 9' and 'Table 11.4' for Tables 3 and 6; '1-2M KLOC' monorepos and '500,000 lines of code (KLOC)' unit confusion; claim of '80 hours into minutes' cited to an SLR. Table 6 values read from a jumbled extraction (column order rebuilt from the variance column). No data or replication package (none applicable). No pre-registration. Licence CC BY-SA 4.0.
